text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Jordan overnight switched its optional-origin wheat purchase to 50,000 tonnes Canadian wheat from U.S. hard red winter wheat for delivery Aug 15-Oct 15, grain trade sources said. Jordan's tender Wednesday called for two optional-origin cargoes of 50,000 tonnes each for two delivery periods: Aug 15-Sept 15 and Sept 15-Oct 15, one source said. U.S. exporters bid at just under US$172.00 a tonne, C and F. Canadian Wheat Board countered with a bid of US$169.00 CIF. Another source placed the CWB's bid closer to US$171.00 CIF.

WHEAT SALES - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought 99,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat in three 33,000-tonne shipments on Thursday. The shipments contain dark northern spring, hard red winter, white wheat and spring wheat, all for delivery from the Pacific Northwest.

- Algeria bought at least 150,000 tonnes of durum wheat from Syria and 100,000 tonnes of milling wheat from Canada, European traders said. There was no official confirmation of the deals and price details were lacking.
CORN SALE - Taiwan's Hui Shung Group bought a shipment of 54,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans from Cargill at a tender.
RICE AND CORN/SOY BLEND SALE - The CCC bought a total of 10,000 tonnes U.S. long grain and medium grain rice and 5,000 tonnes corn/soy blend for donation to North Korea.
The rice was for shipment in bulk, of which 3,000 tonnes was bought at $334.08 a tonne and 7,000 tonnes at $334.09 a tonne, FOB, Lake Charles, La.

The corn/soy bend was bought in 25 kg bags in a range of $315.55-$331.97 a tonne. The rice was slated for August 25 to September 10 delivery, and the corn/soy blend delivery was set for August 25, the CCC said. The CCC is part of the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
RICE SALES - The CCC bought 1,780 tonnes U.S. milled rice in 50 kg bags for donation to Burkina Faso for Aug 20-Sept 5.
SOYMEAL TENDER - CCC was seeking up to 7,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean meal in bulk for donation to Nicaragua. The shipment was set for August 10-30. Results were due July 24.
CORN/SOY TENDER - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender on July 29 for a combined shipment of 18,000 tonnes U.S. corn and 12,000 U.S. soybean, traders said on Thursday.
DURUM TENDER - Private Moroccan operators on Thursday launched a tender to purchase 30,000 tonnes of optional-origin durum wheat for delivery between August 25 and September 15.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC was seeking on July 30 up to 3,530 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Honduras. The shipment period was set for Aug 15-Sept 5.
- The CCC was seeking on July 29 up to 4,100 tonnes of U.S. Hard Red Winter wheat for donation to Bosnia. Shipment period was slated for Aug 15-Sept 5.
- Pakistan would be seeking on July 28 a total of 500,000 tonnes optional origin wheat for August 11-Sept 10 shipment.

VEGOIL TENDER - El Salvador said it was seeking about 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow cottonseed oil in bulk and about 750 to 1,250 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said. Offers are to be received by July 29 and remain valid until July 30. The shipment dates for both commodities were slated for September 10-25.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs will receive offers until July 23 to buy 24,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery, a GEZA spokesman said. Results would be available on July 24.

MARKET TALK - Southeast Asian buyers are believed to be seeking 350,000 tonnes of corn with Indonesia inquiring for 200,000 tonnes and Thai buyers awaiting government approval to purchase 150,000 tonnes, traders said.
... USDA said it raised by $25 million the amount of GSM-102 credit guarantees available for sales of U.S. farm goods to Pakistan under the Export Credit Guarantee Program.
